newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Perstima, Kelanamas shares up on requotation.
newsitem.headline: Perstima, Kelanamas shares up on requotation.

text.p: Shares of Perusahaan Sadur Timah Malaysia Bhd (Perstima) and Kelanamas Industries Bhd jumped on requotation after a week's suspension.
After five minutes, Perstima was up 1.20 ringgit to 13.00 on volume of 3.5 million shares, while Kelanamas rose 24 cents to 4.80 ringgit with one million shares traded.

Kelanamas said on Monday it has proposed to sell 22.03 percent of its stake in tin-plate maker Perstima to Malaysian businessman Amin Shah Omar Shah for 237.6 million ringgit in cash. The deal would make Amin Shah the single largest shareholder of Perstima.

Kelanamas, which stands to make a capital gain of 110.88 million ringgit from the sale, said the disposal would also allow the company to streamline its business activities to stockbroking, property, quarrying and soft drinks operations.
